purpose: Rules for running Python scripts and managing dependencies with uv, so version numbers are chosen and written by uv rather than by hand, including locking, updating, and delayed adoption.
summary: Applicability: applies when project instructions require uv; distribution and stdlib-only cases
Where to declare dependencies: PEP 723 inline metadata versus project pyproject.toml
Execution: run scripts with uv run and declare Python and dependencies in metadata
Adding and removing dependencies with uv add/remove --script, never hand-writing versions
Locking with uv lock --script and verifying with uv run --locked
Updating dependencies with uv tree --outdated and uv lock --upgrade
Excluding versions newer than 3 days via exclude-newer, with per-package exceptions
Python version: requires-python lower bound follows latest stable release
tasks: Writing or running a Python script with dependencies
Handling supply chain risk for new package versions
title: uv 利用ルール
